retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, grainy black and white portrait style featuring subjects in a confrontational pose with a stark white background and a prominent parental advisory badge.
triggerTerms: grainy black and white photography with advisory label
excludeWhen: clean high-resolution commercial photography is needed
soft lighting or pastel tones are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, desaturated monochrome composition characterized by blown-out highlights and deep, crushed blacks. The subjects are positioned in a tight, overlapping arrangement against a flat white void, creating a sense of claustrophobia and raw intensity. The image features heavy digital grain and a signature content warning badge in the lower corner.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast interplay between subjects and a flat white background
Overlapping figures creating a single dense visual mass
Juxtaposition of domestic clothing with aggressive posturing
Textual elements integrated as tattoos or overlays on skin
coreInvariants: Extreme high-contrast black and white tonal range
Heavy film grain or digital noise texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects occupy the center and right-center, scaled to fill approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central subject's face and the high-contrast hand gesture in the lower left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top subject's eyes, moves down to the second subject's tilted head, and terminates at the advisory badge in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Stark white negative space concentrated in the upper left and top edges.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for skin texture and grain
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast with minimal mid-tone transition.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, condensed verticality for the main badge
Small, spaced-out serif characters for skin overlays
characterSpecificRedesigns: Condensed 'ADVISORY' text to fit a specific rectangular block
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-impact industrial sans-serif paired with delicate, spaced-out serifs for a 'found' or 'DIY' aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Rectangular framing for the advisory badge

preserve: The blocky structure of the advisory label

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the advisory badge.
Provides the raw, typewriter or basic serif look for the skin overlays.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, grainy black and white photo of two people in a tight portrait against a pure white background. The lighting should be harsh, creating deep shadows. Apply a heavy film grain filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a black rectangular badge in the bottom right corner with white condensed sans-serif text. Add small, spaced-out serif text as tattoos on the foreheads of the subjects.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without detail?
Is the grain texture visible across the subjects?
Is the advisory badge positioned in the lower right quadrant?

mustRedesign: Modern, clean sans-serifs for the forehead text
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no color artifacts are present
Verify the text is legible but integrated into the lo-fi style
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W + Heavy Grain + White Void Background + Blocky Advisory Overlay
